name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Rios, Forge, and Geode belong to different colonists.
Drift goes with either Eklund or Basalt (but not both).
Rios, Drift, and Basalt belong to different colonists.
